macosDeploymentTargetNote: Electron 45.4.1 supports macOS Ventura (13) and up (electron/electron v45.4.1 README, read 2026-11-23); the bundled tools must not ask for less than the app itself.

sources.name: ffmpeg
sources.note: ffmpeg.org publishes no SHA-256 (vetting 0006 section 10.3). This value is the Homebrew formula's pin for the same URL (formulae.brew.sh/api/formula/ffmpeg.json, read twice on 2026-11-23). The detached OpenPGP signature below is checked as well, so a wrong value here stops the build rather than admitting another file.

sources.name: x264
sources.note: Head of the upstream 'stable' branch (code.videolan.org API, read 2026-11-23, committed 2025-06-08); Homebrew's x264 r3222 pins the same revision. The reason this build is GPL.

sources.name: lame
sources.note: The publisher lists MD5 only (sourceforge.net/projects/lame/rss?path=/lame, read 2026-11-23). The SHA-256 is the Homebrew formula's pin for the same URL (formulae.brew.sh/api/formula/lame.json, read 2026-11-23); both are checked. Needed for libmp3lame: local-voice.ts writes narration.mp3.
